answer: Each identity must harbor an instrumented station: enrollment attests a device key, locks a deposit and triangulates its coordinates by latency, refusing closer pairs. Per epoch each node draws a nonce-signed task no neighbour gets: return device-signed wind from your anemometer as a gale crosses your coordinates (calm burns the deposit), or plate tonight's comet at a stated UTC second, checked against ephemerides, duplicate hashes refused. Shared readings cannot cover two nodes: each puppet needs its own site, sensor and deposit, so cost grows linearly with N while an honest user pays once.
